load_scan_mesh: load a ScanNet++ scene mesh with xyz coordinates, rgb colors, and segmentation labels from a PLY file
get_camera_poses: get camera-to-world pose matrices for selected frames of a ScanNet++ scene as a stacked tensor
get_camera_intrinsics: get camera intrinsic matrices scaled to the resized image shape for selected frames of a scene
get_rgb_images: get resized and normalized RGB images as tensors for selected frames of a ScanNet++ scene
get_camera_views: get a combined dict of poses, intrinsics, RGB images, and depth z-buffers for selected frames of a scene
